public_rationale: The result differs by referent. For Microsoft, the claim is contradicted: the company had explicitly excluded cyber activity and AI involvement on November 13. For the FAA, reporting supports qualified uncertainty because the underlying cause remained under investigation. However, that report also says SMART had been ruled out. The mixed assessment reflects these different readings; it does not establish that either outage involved a cyberattack or an LLM failure.
limitations: The ambiguous referent materially determines the result.
An unfinished investigation does not make the two proposed causes equally plausible.
Official statements establish the public account at the time, not an independently verified final technical cause.
